summary:
Plan to redesign the top header navbar to be clean, responsive, and prevent overlap on mobile devices while retaining the NO/EN language switcher.
- Shrink touch targets cleanly with icon-only or shortened labels on mobile screens (<640px)
- Hide duplicate/redundant buttons on mobile (e.g. separate profile switch button, since clicking the profile badge already opens the profile modal)
- Make "Ny turnering" compact on mobile (icon with optional short text on larger viewports)
- Give PadelFlex logo and title explicit min-w-0 and prevent shrinking so it is never compressed or overlapped
